title: Female Ground Glass Hose Adapter/Vapour Bag Mouthpiece
description:
It is the little things that makes life easy. This ground glass hose adapter is the perfect accompaniment to a vapor tamer and also comes in handy when you require the connection from male 18mm ground glass joint to whip/hose.
You may also want a sick clip to help keep the adapter in place.
Included
1 x 18mm Female Whip Adapter
